purpose: Three differentiated 45s English electronic/groove chorus demos avoiding the Tech-House vocal-drop trap.

demos.title: Turn It On
demos.direction: Melodic House Pop, 124 BPM, C minor, cool female hook vocal, -on/-one rhyme.
demos.caption: Catchy Melodic House Pop and upbeat Dance-Pop at 124 BPM in C minor with an immediate vocal chorus hook from beat one. Crisp cool solo female vocals singing clearly upfront through the opening chorus, full melodic verse and final chorus, no long instrumental drop. Punchy four-on-the-floor kick, warm groovy synth bassline, bright plucky house piano chords and crisp hi-hats. Infectious short-phrase earworm chorus, clean modern mix with clear English diction.
demos.lyrics:
[Chorus]
Turn it on, turn it on right now
Feel the spark light up the crowd
Step by step we figure how
Turn it on, turn it on right now
[Verse]
Quiet room and glowing screen
Sharpest focus I have seen
Every line falls into place
Moving at our steady pace
[Chorus]
Turn it on, turn it on right now
Feel the spark light up the crowd
Nothing slows the rhythm down
Turn it on, turn it on right now

demos.title: Right On Time
demos.direction: Indie Electro-Funk / Nu-Disco, 114 BPM, G major, relaxed male groove vocal, -ai diphthong rhyme.
demos.caption: Groovy Indie Electro-Funk and sunlit Nu-Disco Pop at 114 BPM in G major, starting right on the chorus hook with zero slow intro. Smooth confident solo male vocals with crisp English articulation and effortless bounce. Elastic electric bassline, tight dry funk drum groove, clean rhythmic guitar chops and warm analog synth brass accents. Sings clearly through opening chorus, tight melodic verse and final chorus.
demos.lyrics:
[Chorus]
Right on time, we are right on time
Every piece begins to shine
Keep the rhythm on the line
Right on time, we are right on time
[Verse]
Morning coffee in my hand
Simple plan at my command
Small ideas start to grow
Watch the steady current flow
[Chorus]
Right on time, we are right on time
Every piece begins to shine
Leave the heavy noise behind
Right on time, we are right on time

demos.title: Neon Sky
demos.direction: Melodic Synthwave / Outrun Pop, 118 BPM, D minor, soaring female synth-pop vocal, -ai/-ait rhyme.
demos.caption: Anthemic 80s-inspired Melodic Synthwave and Outrun Electropop at 118 BPM in D minor. Bright soaring solo female vocals with crystal-clear English pronunciation and uplifting energy. Punchy retro drum machine kick, classic gated reverb snare, driving sixteenth-note octave synth bass, shimmering Juno chorus pads and brassy analog synth lead hook. Immediate synth hook into verse and double chorus, vocals upfront throughout.
demos.lyrics:
[Verse]
City sleeping down below
Silver circuits start to glow
Leave the heavy doubts behind
[Chorus]
Underneath the neon sky
Turn the volume up tonight
We are running fast and high
Chasing every streak of light
[Chorus]
Underneath the neon sky
Let the wild ideas fly
Nothing left to hold us back
